messages:
Ana Chen: Hey folks, first week quick one: where do I find the canonical engineering docs in Notion? I landed on a bunch of team pages but can't edit templates I want to copy. Who owns permissions?
Sam DevEx: welcome Ana! Canonical eng docs live in the Eng space (top-left workspace menu). If you're view-only you probably have Org Viewer. We have two groups: Docs Editors (can edit) and Docs Maintainers (can change templates & page ownership).
Ana Chen: ah ok. How do I get into Docs Editors?
Rae People Ops: tag: added you to Docs Editors. You should see an invite email to ana.chen@redwood.ai. If Notion was open, sign out and back in. If you still can't edit, paste the page link and we'll check page-level locks.
notion-permissions-bot: Invite queued for ana.chen@redwood.ai to group "Docs Editors"  status: sent.
Ana Chen: got it, accepted. Duplicate enabled now. Quick followup: we want a runbook template with prefilled kubectl commands and a top-level incident checklist. Is there an org template for that?
Diego Eng: yes, use the "Runbook + Incident" in DevEx templates. Link: https://redwood.notion.site/devex/runbook-incident-template. If you need prefilled commands, include them as locked code blocks so they don't get accidentally edited.
Ana Chen: what's the process to add our team variant to the org library? I don't want to create a private copy forever.
Sam DevEx: preferred flow: 1) Duplicate template to your workspace, make edits; 2) Open a docs-templates PR in the infra repo with the Notion page link and short changelog; 3) Request review from Docs Maintainers. After approval, a maintainer will add it to the DevEx templates library with tags.
Ana Chen: what metadata tags do templates need?
Diego Eng: we use a small set: [template] [owner:<team>] [visibility:org|team] [category:runbook|onboarding|howto] and optional [last-reviewed:<date>]. Putting those at the top of the page in a small property table makes automation easier.
Ana Chen: encountered a locked block on a runbook I tried to copy (can't duplicate locked blocks). Is unlocking allowed?
Rae People Ops: owners lock blocks for safety. If you need an editable copy, ask the page owner to create an unlocked duplicate, or request a temporary unlock. If iteels like a template change, file the PR instead and the maintainers will handle merging unlocked content.
Ana Chen: small gotcha: when I duplicate, @group mentions turn into plain text. Any tips?
Diego Eng: yep that's expected. After duplicating, replace org-level mentions with the correct group from your workspace or add a note like @oncall -> replace with actual rotation link.
Ana Chen: one more: where's the onboarding checklist template? I want to add infra-specific steps.
Sam DevEx: People Ops owns onboarding checklists: https://redwood.notion.site/people-ops/onboarding. Copy "New Hire: Eng onboarding" and add a linked database property to your team board for team-specific tasks. If you want it org-wide, follow the same PR flow.
Ana Chen: perfect, thanks all. Can someone point me to a 10-min walkthrough of the templates library?
Rae People Ops: happy to do a quick walkthrough tomorrow at 11am PT. I'll post a calendar invite in #devex.
Ana Chen: thanks! Appreciate the help :smile:
